senses.gloss:
m. (-शः)
A Caṇḍāla, an outcaste: see पुक्कस.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Low, vile.
m. (-सः)
A Caṇḍāla, or man of an impure and degraded tribe or occupation, born of the Niṣāda by a Śūdra female.
f. (-सी)
1 Indigo.
2 A bud, a blossom.
3 A woman of the Pukkasa tribe.
E.
पु for पुण्य purity, कु bad (understood,) कस to go, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
